source: MAFF / ADB, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean crop], official cultivation manual, 2005
text: Harvest guidance covers timing (pods and foliage turning brown/yellow at physiological maturity) and drying before storage. The manual reports field-trial yield data for two named varieties, DT84 and AGS73, both averaging around 1,450 kg/ha under the trial conditions described, which the manual presents as achievable on-farm yield targets for Cambodian growers using recommended practice.
